hebrewText: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה הָרֵ֣ם אֶֽת מַטְּ/ךָ֗ וּ/נְטֵ֧ה אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֛ עַל הַ/יָּ֖ם וּ/בְקָעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/יָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/יָּ֖ם בַּ/יַּבָּשָֽׁה

tokens.bdb: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high(-er, one), hold up, levy, lift(-er) up, (be) lofty, ([idiom] a-) loud, mount up, offer (up), [phrase] presumptuously, (be) promote(-ion), proud, set up, tall(-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread)
to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.
